basis: a campaign's enrollment decision allows an automatic disposition only when the grader is calibrated against a ratified bar table for its own configuration and production runtime
bars are ratified per grader configuration from a signed audit, and a value with no ratified bar is never rendered
rule: checkCalibration(score, calibration) refuses in this order and holds otherwise: no_calibration when calibration is absent; not_ratified when it lacks ratifiedBy, ratifiedAt or auditRef (absent or empty); not_production when the calibration's graderConfiguration.runtime is development; configuration_mismatch when any of the eight key parts differs (enrichmentType id and version, the type's version an integer, rubric id and version, model, prompt name, version and contentHash, runtime); not_scored when outcome is not scored; no_accepted_engine_grade when no grade has evidencedBy engine and accepted true; unbarred_criterion when such a grade's criterionId has no bar; below_bar when such a grade's confidence is absent or below its threshold, compared as exact decimals across scales, a criterion barred twice being read at its stricter (higher) threshold. criterionIds lists, sorted, the criteria the last two are about, and is empty otherwise. Grades with evidencedBy operator, or accepted false, are not read. Vectors CO-1 to CO-6 each trip two conditions and expect the earlier; no_calibration with not_ratified, and no_accepted_engine_grade with unbarred_criterion, cannot occur together. The thresholds and confidences in these vectors are synthetic.

vectors.why: every accepted engine grade clears its bar; the operator grade is not read
an empty bar table, every grade accepted, fails
a rubric whose criteria are all operator-evidenced fails: never vacuously true
no bar table at all
a prompt whose content changed: bars do not transfer
another rubric version
one grade below its bar
a confidence equal to its bar clears it (at least)
decimals compare exactly, across scales: 0.6999 is below 0.70
0.7000 equals 0.70 and 0.6000 equals 0.60: a scale-4 confidence against a scale-2 threshold
an engine grade code did not accept is not read
an accepted engine grade with no bar fails, whatever the others do
an accepted engine grade with no confidence (a hand-built input that breaks the rule that every engine grade carries a confidence) cannot clear a bar: the predicate stays total
engine grades, none accepted: fails
another version of the enrichment type: the type's version is part of the key
a disqualified score is never calibrated itself; campaigns checks each inferred input of its disqualifier instead
a calibration without its audit reference is not ratified
a criterion barred twice (a producer error: each criterion is barred at most once), the grade between the two thresholds: the stricter bar is read, so the error can only refuse
an auditRef of "": a ratification field lacks when it is absent or empty
a ratified development calibration checked against a score of its own development configuration, every accepted engine grade clearing its bar: development bars authorize no automatic disposition
a ratified production calibration whose seven other key parts equal a development score's, every accepted engine grade clearing its bar: production bars never calibrate a development score
the score's enrichment type id differs, every other part equal: bars do not transfer
the score's rubric id differs, every other part equal
the score's prompt name differs, every other part equal
the score's prompt version differs, every other part equal
a calibration with no ratifiedBy is not ratified
a calibration with no ratifiedAt is not ratified
C-18 with the two bars listed the other way round: the stricter bar is read wherever it is listed, so neither first-listed nor last-listed wins
not ratified and a configuration mismatch at once: not_ratified is checked first
a configuration mismatch and a disqualified outcome at once: configuration_mismatch is checked first
a disqualified outcome with no accepted engine grade: not_scored is checked first
one criterion unbarred and another below its bar: unbarred_criterion is checked first, and names only the unbarred one
not ratified and a development calibration at once: not_ratified is checked first
a development calibration against a production score, so a configuration mismatch too: not_production is checked first
